name: dynamo.run_graph
description: Runs a Dynamo graph (.dyn file) within the active Revit session. Optional `inputs` are mapped by name to nodes flagged 'IsInput' in Dynamo and applied before the run. Outputs are read from any node flagged 'IsOutput'. Supports primitive input value types: string, integer, number, and boolean. If you don't already know the graph's input node names, call `dynamo.describe_graph` first to discover them — do not guess input keys.

graph_path.description: Absolute path to the Dynamo graph file (.dyn).

inputs.description: Optional key-value pairs. Keys must match the *Name* of nodes flagged as inputs in Dynamo (right-click node → 'Is Input'). Values must be string, integer, number, or boolean — matching the input node's value type.

inputs_applied.description: Names of inputs that were successfully applied to the graph.

unknown_inputs.description: Input names from the request that did not match any IsInput-flagged node.

outputs.description: Map of output node Name → value, populated from nodes flagged 'Is Output' in Dynamo. Empty if the graph has no output nodes.

examples.description: Run a graph with no inputs (fire-and-forget)
Run a graph that takes a single string input named 'String' and writes it to the Mark parameter on every wall
